doyo.note: Opens with Victor's 78s of 1928-1932: Hirai Hideko, the child star of Nakayama Shinpei and Noguchi Ujō's songs, often with Nakayama himself credited, and Satō Chiyako's Amefuri otsukisan, then Motoori Nagayo's Nanatsu no ko and Akai kutsu sung by Honda Nobuko, and Kawada Masako's postwar radio songs with the Columbia Orchestra (Sato no aki, Mikan no hana saku oka). The last part is the classics of Kitahara Hakushū and Yamada Kōsaku and of the Akai Tori and Kin no Fune magazines as later singers and choirs keep them. Release years are given only where Wikipedia dates that singer's record of the song; the other year is when the song was published.
